name: paranoidal-deep-storage
title: Paranoidal Deep Storage
author: notnotmelon (Memory Storage, Fluid Memory Storage), restjack (Logistic Memory Units); Paranoidal (merge and rewrite)
description: Paranoidal: one mod instead of Memory Storage and Fluid Memory Storage. Memory units store an endless amount of one item (plain and logistic variants) or one fluid; the more is stored, the more power they need. One scheduler drives both kinds.
